potion.name: Potion
potion.description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. Restores 20 HP.

super_potion.name: Super Potion
super_potion.description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. Restores 50 HP.

hyper_potion.name: Hyper Potion
hyper_potion.description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. Restores 200 HP.

max_potion.name: Max Potion
max_potion.description: A spray-type medicine for treating wounds. Fully restores a Pokémon's HP.

full_restore.name: Full Restore
full_restore.description: Fully restores HP and heals any status conditions of a Pokémon.

revive.name: Revive
revive.description: Revives a fainted Pokémon, restoring half of its maximum HP.

max_revive.name: Max Revive
max_revive.description: Revives a fainted Pokémon, fully restoring its maximum HP.

pokeball.name: Poké Ball
pokeball.description: A tool for catching wild Pokémon.

great_ball.name: Great Ball
great_ball.description: A good, high-performance Ball that provides a higher catch rate than a standard Poké Ball.

ultra_ball.name: Ultra Ball
ultra_ball.description: A better, high-performance Ball that provides an even higher catch rate than a Great Ball.

master_ball.name: Master Ball
master_ball.description: The best Ball with the ultimate performance. It will catch any wild Pokémon without fail.

antidote.name: Antidote
antidote.description: A medicine that heals a poisoned Pokémon.

burn_heal.name: Burn Heal
burn_heal.description: A medicine that heals a Pokémon suffering from a burn.

ice_heal.name: Ice Heal
ice_heal.description: A medicine that defrosts a frozen Pokémon.

awakening.name: Awakening
awakening.description: A medicine that wakes up a sleeping Pokémon.

paralyz_heal.name: Paralyz Heal
paralyz_heal.description: A medicine that heals a paralyzed Pokémon.

full_heal.name: Full Heal
full_heal.description: A medicine that heals all status conditions of a Pokémon.

escape_rope.name: Escape Rope
escape_rope.description: A long, durable rope. Use it to escape instantly from a cave or dungeon.

repel.name: Repel
repel.description: Repels weak wild Pokémon for 100 steps.

super_repel.name: Super Repel
super_repel.description: Repels weak wild Pokémon for 200 steps.

max_repel.name: Max Repel
max_repel.description: Repels weak wild Pokémon for 250 steps.

fire_stone.name: Fire Stone
fire_stone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is colored orange.

water_stone.name: Water Stone
water_stone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is a clear light blue.

thunder_stone.name: Thunder Stone
thunder_stone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is thunderbolt-yellow.

leaf_stone.name: Leaf Stone
leaf_stone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It has a leaf pattern.

moon_stone.name: Moon Stone
moon_stone.description: A peculiar stone that makes certain species of Pokémon evolve. It is as black as night.

town_map.name: Town Map
town_map.description: A very convenient map that can be viewed anytime. It even shows your present location.

bicycle.name: Bicycle
bicycle.description: A folding bike that allows faster movement than the Running Shoes.

coin_case.name: Coin Case
coin_case.description: A case for holding Coins obtained at the Game Corner. It holds up to 9,999 coins.

itemfinder.name: Itemfinder
itemfinder.description: A device used for finding items. If there is a hidden item nearby, it emits a signal.

old_rod.name: Old Rod
old_rod.description: An old and beat-up fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish for wild Pokémon.

good_rod.name: Good Rod
good_rod.description: A decent fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish up wild Pokémon.

super_rod.name: Super Rod
super_rod.description: An awesome, high-tech fishing rod. Use it by any body of water to fish up all kinds of Pokémon.

tm01.name: TM01 (Mega Punch)
tm01.description: A powerful punch thrown with maximal force.

tm02.name: TM02 (Razor Wind)
tm02.description: Razor-sharp winds slash at the foe.

tm03.name: TM03 (Swords Dance)
tm03.description: A frenetic dance that sharply raises the user's Attack.

tm04.name: TM04 (Whirlwind)
tm04.description: A gust of wind blows the foe away.

tm05.name: TM05 (Mega Kick)
tm05.description: A powerful kick thrown with maximal force.

tm06.name: TM06 (Toxic)
tm06.description: A move that badly poisons the foe. Its poison damage worsens every turn.

tm07.name: TM07 (Horn Drill)
tm07.description: A drilling attack that knocks out the foe in one hit if it lands.

tm08.name: TM08 (Body Slam)
tm08.description: The user slams its full weight into the foe.

tm09.name: TM09 (Take Down)
tm09.description: A reckless charging attack that also hurts the user.

tm10.name: TM10 (Double Edge)
tm10.description: A reckless tackle that also hurts the user.

tm11.name: TM11 (Bubble Beam)
tm11.description: A forceful spray of bubbles is fired at the foe.

tm12.name: TM12 (Water Gun)
tm12.description: A squirt of water is shot at the foe.

tm13.name: TM13 (Ice Beam)
tm13.description: The foe is struck with an icy beam. It may freeze the foe solid.

tm14.name: TM14 (Blizzard)
tm14.description: The foe is blasted with a blizzard. It may freeze the foe solid.

tm15.name: TM15 (Hyper Beam)
tm15.description: A severely damaging attack that makes the user rest on the next turn.

tm16.name: TM16 (Pay Day)
tm16.description: Coins are scattered about, earning extra money after the battle.

tm17.name: TM17 (Submission)
tm17.description: A reckless wrestling throw that also hurts the user.

tm18.name: TM18 (Counter)
tm18.description: Returns double the damage taken from a physical hit.

tm19.name: TM19 (Seismic Toss)
tm19.description: A gravity-defying throw that deals damage equal to the user's level.

tm20.name: TM20 (Rage)
tm20.description: An attack that grows in power each time the user is hit.

tm21.name: TM21 (Mega Drain)
tm21.description: Drains the foe's health to restore the user's HP.

tm22.name: TM22 (Solar Beam)
tm22.description: A 2-turn move that absorbs light to attack on the second turn.

tm23.name: TM23 (Dragon Rage)
tm23.description: A blast of dragon energy that always deals 40 damage.

tm24.name: TM24 (Thunderbolt)
tm24.description: A strong electrical blast is loosed at the foe. It may cause paralysis.

tm25.name: TM25 (Thunder)
tm25.description: A brutal lightning attack that may paralyze the foe. It hits straight in rain.

tm26.name: TM26 (Earthquake)
tm26.description: An earthquake that strikes all Pokémon in battle excluding the user.

tm27.name: TM27 (Fissure)
tm27.description: A ground-splitting attack that knocks out the foe in one hit if it lands.

tm28.name: TM28 (Dig)
tm28.description: The user burrows on the first turn and strikes on the second.

tm29.name: TM29 (Psychic)
tm29.description: A strong telekinetic attack. It may lower the foe's Sp. Def stat.

tm30.name: TM30 (Teleport)
tm30.description: Vanishes instantly to flee from wild battles.

tm31.name: TM31 (Mimic)
tm31.description: Copies the foe's last move for the rest of the battle.

tm32.name: TM32 (Double Team)
tm32.description: Moves create illusory copies to raise the user's evasiveness.

tm33.name: TM33 (Reflect)
tm33.description: A wall of light cuts damage from physical attacks for five turns.

tm34.name: TM34 (Bide)
tm34.description: The user stores energy for two turns, then unleashes double the damage taken.

tm35.name: TM35 (Metronome)
tm35.description: Waggles a finger to unleash a completely random move.

tm36.name: TM36 (Self Destruct)
tm36.description: A massive explosion that knocks out the user as well.

tm37.name: TM37 (Egg Bomb)
tm37.description: A barrage of eggs is hurled at the foe.

tm38.name: TM38 (Fire Blast)
tm38.description: The foe is incinerated with an intense flame. It may cause a burn.

tm39.name: TM39 (Swift)
tm39.description: A star-shaped ray that never misses.

tm40.name: TM40 (Skull Bash)
tm40.description: The user tucks in its head, then rams the foe on the next turn.

tm41.name: TM41 (Soft-Boiled)
tm41.description: Restores the user's HP by up to half of its maximum.

tm42.name: TM42 (Dream Eater)
tm42.description: Eats the foe's dreams to restore HP. Fails if the foe is awake.

tm43.name: TM43 (Sky Attack)
tm43.description: A second-turn diving charge, wreathed in light.

tm44.name: TM44 (Rest)
tm44.description: The user sleeps for 2 turns to fully restore HP and cure status conditions.

tm45.name: TM45 (Thunder Wave)
tm45.description: A weak electric shock that paralyzes the foe.

tm46.name: TM46 (Psywave)
tm46.description: A wave of psychic energy. Damage varies with the user's level.

tm47.name: TM47 (Explosion)
tm47.description: The ultimate explosion. It knocks out the user as well.

tm48.name: TM48 (Rock Slide)
tm48.description: Large boulders are hurled at the foe.

tm49.name: TM49 (Tri Attack)
tm49.description: A triple strike that may also burn, freeze, or paralyze the foe.

tm50.name: TM50 (Substitute)
tm50.description: The user creates a decoy using some of its own HP.

tm51.name: TM51 (Focus Punch)
tm51.description: An attack that is executed last. The user flinches if hit beforehand.

tm52.name: TM52 (Dragon Claw)
tm52.description: Sharp, huge claws hook and slash the foe quickly and with great power.

tm53.name: TM53 (Water Pulse)
tm53.description: An attack with a pulsing blast of water. It may also confuse the foe.

tm54.name: TM54 (Calm Mind)
tm54.description: The user focuses its mind to raise the Sp. Atk and Sp. Def stats.

tm55.name: TM55 (Roar)
tm55.description: The foe is made to switch out with an ally. In the wild, the battle ends.

tm56.name: TM56 (Hail)
tm56.description: A hailstorm lasting five turns damages all Pokémon except the Ice-type.

tm57.name: TM57 (Bulk Up)
tm57.description: The user bulks up its body to boost both its Attack and Defense stats.

tm58.name: TM58 (Bullet Seed)
tm58.description: The user shoots seeds at the foe. Two to five seeds are shot at once.

tm59.name: TM59 (Hidden Power)
tm59.description: An attack that varies in type and intensity depending on the user.

tm60.name: TM60 (Sunny Day)
tm60.description: The sun blazes for five turns, powering up Fire-type moves.

tm61.name: TM61 (Taunt)
tm61.description: The foe is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves.

tm62.name: TM62 (Light Screen)
tm62.description: A wall of light cuts damage from Sp. Atk attacks for five turns.

tm63.name: TM63 (Protect)
tm63.description: Enables the user to evade all attacks. It may fail if used in succession.

tm64.name: TM64 (Rain Dance)
tm64.description: A heavy rain falls for five turns, powering up Water-type moves.

tm65.name: TM65 (Giga Drain)
tm65.description: A harsh attack that absorbs half the damage it inflicted to restore HP.

tm66.name: TM66 (Safeguard)
tm66.description: It protects the user's party from all status problems for five turns.

tm67.name: TM67 (Frustration)
tm67.description: A full-power attack that grows harsher the less the user likes its trainer.

tm68.name: TM68 (Iron Tail)
tm68.description: The foe is slammed with a steel-hard tail. It may lower Defense.

tm69.name: TM69 (Return)
tm69.description: An attack that builds power the more the user loves its trainer.

tm70.name: TM70 (Shadow Ball)
tm70.description: The user hurls a black blob that may lower the foe's Sp. Def stat.

tm71.name: TM71 (Brick Break)
tm71.description: Destroys barriers like Light Screen and Reflect and causes damage.

tm72.name: TM72 (Shock Wave)
tm72.description: The user strikes the target with a quick, unevadable electric shock.

tm73.name: TM73 (Flamethrower)
tm73.description: The foe is scorched with an intense blast of fire. It may cause a burn.

tm74.name: TM74 (Sludge Bomb)
tm74.description: Unsanitary sludge is hurled at the target. It may poison the foe.

tm75.name: TM75 (Sandstorm)
tm75.description: A 5-turn sandstorm buffets the battlefield, damaging non-rock/ground/steel types.

tm76.name: TM76 (Rock Tomb)
tm76.description: Boulders are hurled at the foe. It lowers the target's Speed stat.

tm77.name: TM77 (Aerial Ace)
tm77.description: An extremely fast attack that is completely unevadable.

tm78.name: TM78 (Torment)
tm78.description: Torments the foe and stops it from using the same move twice in a row.

tm79.name: TM79 (Facade)
tm79.description: Boosts Attack power if the user is burned, paralyzed, or poisoned.

tm80.name: TM80 (Secret Power)
tm80.description: An attack that has varying secondary effects depending on the environment.

tm81.name: TM81 (Attract)
tm81.description: Lowers the foe's Attack and Sp. Atk by one stage.

tm82.name: TM82 (Steel Wing)
tm82.description: The target is struck with rigid wings. It may raise the user's Defense.

tm83.name: TM83 (Snatch)
tm83.description: Steals the effects of the foe's healing or status moves on that turn.

tm84.name: TM84 (Overheat)
tm84.description: A full-power blast that severely lowers the user's Special Attack afterward.

hm01.name: HM01 (Cut)
hm01.description: Allows the user to cut down small trees outside of battle. Deals Normal-type damage.

hm02.name: HM02 (Fly)
hm02.description: The user flies up on the second turn and drops down to attack. Allows instant travel between visited towns.

hm03.name: HM03 (Surf)
hm03.description: The user plows across water to hit the foe. Allows the trainer to surf across water bodies.

hm04.name: HM04 (Strength)
hm04.description: The target is hammered with a physical blow. Allows the user to push heavy boulders out of the way.

hm05.name: HM05 (Flash)
hm05.description: A powerful flash of light blinds the target, reducing accuracy. Illuminates pitch-dark caves.

hm06.name: HM06 (Rock Smash)
hm06.description: The foe is hit with an impact that can lower Defense. Smashes cracked rocks blocking paths.

hm07.name: HM07 (Waterfall)
hm07.description: The user charges at the target at a high speed. Powerful enough to charge up waterfalls.

poke_doll.name: Poké Doll
poke_doll.description: An attractive doll. Use it to distract a-and flee from any wild Pokémon.

x_accuracy.name: X Accuracy
x_accuracy.description: Temporarily heightens the accuracy of attacks during a battle.

guard_spec.name: Guard Spec.
guard_spec.description: Prevents the Pokémon's stats from being reduced during a battle.

dire_hit.name: Dire Hit
dire_hit.description: Raises the critical-hit ratio of a Pokémon during a battle.

x_attack.name: X Attack
x_attack.description: Temporarily raises the Attack stat of a Pokémon during a battle.

x_defend.name: X Defend
x_defend.description: Temporarily raises the Defense stat of a Pokémon during a battle.

x_speed.name: X Speed
x_speed.description: Temporarily raises the Speed stat of a Pokémon during a battle.

x_special.name: X Special
x_special.description: Temporarily raises the Special stat of a Pokémon during a battle.

hp_up.name: HP Up
hp_up.description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base HP of a single Pokémon.

protein.name: Protein
protein.description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Attack stat of a single Pokémon.

iron.name: Iron
iron.description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Defense stat of a single Pokémon.

carbos.name: Carbos
carbos.description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises the base Speed stat of a single Pokémon.

calcium.name: Calcium
calcium.description: A nutritious drink for Pokémon. It raises base Special stats of a single Pokémon.

fresh_water.name: Fresh Water
fresh_water.description: Water with a high mineral content. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 50 points.

soda_pop.name: Soda Pop
soda_pop.description: A fizzy soda drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 60 points.

lemonade.name: Lemonade
lemonade.description: A very sweet drink. It restores the HP of one Pokémon by 80 points.

ether.name: Ether
ether.description: Restores the PP of a selected move by 10 points for a single Pokémon.

max_ether.name: Max Ether
max_ether.description: Fully restores the PP of a selected move for a single Pokémon.

elixir.name: Elixir
elixir.description: Restores the PP of all moves by 10 points for a single Pokémon.

max_elixir.name: Max Elixir
max_elixir.description: Fully restores the PP of all moves for a single Pokémon.

pp_up.name: PP Up
pp_up.description: A nutritious item that raises the maximum PP of a selected move for a Pokémon.

helix_fossil.name: Helix Fossil
helix_fossil.description: A piece of an ancient marine Pokémon's seashell. It is fossilized and somewhat urn-shaped.

dome_fossil.name: Dome Fossil
dome_fossil.description: A piece of an ancient marine Pokémon's shell. It is fossilized and tapers to a point.

old_amber.name: Old Amber
old_amber.description: A piece of amber that contains the genetic material of an ancient aerial Pokémon.

poke_flute.name: Poké Flute
poke_flute.description: A flute that is said to instantly awaken any Pokémon. It has a lovely tone.

silph_scope.name: Silph Scope
silph_scope.description: A scope that makes unseeable Pokémon visible. It is made by Silph Co.

gold_teeth.name: Gold Teeth
gold_teeth.description: A set of false teeth lost by the Safari Zone's Warden. It makes his smile sparkle.

secret_key.name: Secret Key
secret_key.description: The key to Cinnabar Island Gym's front door. It is colored red and decorated.

card_key.name: Card Key
card_key.description: A card-type key that unlocks doors in Silph Co.'s head office in Saffron City.

lift_key.name: Lift Key
lift_key.description: A key that operates the elevator in Team Rocket's hideout. It bears the Team Rocket logo.

linking_cord.name: Linking Cord
linking_cord.description: A string exuding a mysterious energy that makes you feel a strange sense of connection. It's loved by certain Pokémon.

fishing_rod.name: Fishing Rod
fishing_rod.description: A rod for fishing up water-dwelling Pokémon.

safari_ball.name: Safari Ball
safari_ball.description: A special Ball used only in the Safari Zone.

rare_candy.name: Rare Candy
rare_candy.description: A candy that raises the level of a Pokémon by one.

nugget.name: Nugget
nugget.description: A nugget of pure gold. Sell it for a high price.

bike.name: Bicycle
bike.description: A folding bicycle that lets you move around much faster.

stardust.name: Stardust
stardust.description: A pretty red sand. Sell it for a decent price.
